headline: Apple's smart home hub reportedly launching in mid-October
summary: Apple's long-rumored smart home hub is reportedly set to be revealed around mid-October, alongside a new HomePod mini and upgraded Apple TV, according to Bloomberg's Mark Gurman. The devices are expected to showcase Apple's overhauled Siri AI assistant.
